name: L-701324
summary: L-701324 is an antagonist of the NMDA receptor. It appears to have activity in animal models of depression.

pharmacology.text: L-701324 appears to be an antagonist of the NMDA receptor and acts at the glycine binding site. This means that it prevents the receptor from activating by blocking the binding of glycine, a required co-agonist in addition to glutamate.
